## Acceptance Criteria

This testing task is complete when:

* [ ] The required test cases are implemented or manually verified
* [ ] Tests pass locally
* [ ] Any failing behavior is documented or opened as a separate bug issue
* [ ] The PR explains what was tested
* [ ] A PR is opened and linked to this issue, if code or docs changed
